Zaraa friend harness

Mama Zaraa, portable.

This package installs a local Zaraa dashboard and gateway, keeps private config outside the app folder, and gives you a simple path to update when a newer master release is shared.

Version 2026.07.24-rc.6 / friends

1. Install or update

macOS/Linux: export ZARAA_HOME_DIR=/absolute/isolated/home ./installers/install-macos-linux.sh Windows: $env:ZARAA_HOME_DIR = "C:\absolute\isolated\home" .\installers\install-windows.ps1

2. Connect a model

cd <installed-root> pnpm setup pnpm doctor

Choose Anthropic, OpenRouter, or local Ollama. Existing gateway and safety settings stay intact.

3. Start Zaraa

macOS/Linux: ./installers/start-macos-linux.sh Windows: .\installers\start-windows.ps1

4. Open dashboard

http://localhost:3927/

The Brain Map shell is served fresh each launch, while hashed assets stay safely cached.

5. Read the runbook

docs/friend-harness-install-guide.md docs/friend-package-handoff.md

Do not share local keys, configs, logs, memories, or private workspace data.
